directive:
Re-solve only `thm:ordered-dp` and add a new statement `thm:tree-effect-fiber`; do not reopen `oeq:k-frontier`, `oeq:unique-frontier`, or `oeq:q-lower-bound`.

In `thm:ordered-dp`, replace the coarse \((K+1)2^{q_\pi}\) state bound by
\[
S(q_\pi,K)=\sum_{i=0}^{\min(q_\pi,K)}\binom{q_\pi}{i}(K-i+1),
\]
because a retained state with \(|A_\ell|=i\) has only \(b_\ell\in\{0,\ldots,K-i\}\). State runtime \(S(q_\pi,K)\operatorname{poly}(N)\), retain the old bound as an immediate corollary, and record the sharper \(q_\pi^{O(K)}\operatorname{poly}(N)\) regime when \(K\ll q_\pi\). Preserve decision, uniqueness, and two-witness recovery.

Add `thm:tree-effect-fiber`: if \(\mathcal F_K(\Sigma)=\varnothing\), then \(\Theta_K=\varnothing\); if \(x=y\), every feasible tuple has effect \(1\); if \(x,y\) are in different components, every feasible tuple has effect \(0\). If distinct \(x,y\) lie in component \(T_j\), let \(v\) be the neighbor of \(x\) on the \(x\)-\(y\) path. Prove for every feasible \(\rho\)
\[
\theta_\rho(\Sigma;x,y)=\begin{cases}\Sigma_{yx}/\Sigma_{xx},&r_j\in T_{x;xv},\\0,&r_j\notin T_{x;xv}.\end{cases}
\]
Hence \(\Theta_K(\Sigma;x,y)\subseteq\{0,\Sigma_{yx}/\Sigma_{xx}\}\), with each value present exactly when the corresponding root-side restriction is feasible. Prove both memberships and recover witnesses by running the restricted-root version of `thm:ordered-dp` in \(S(q_\pi,K)\operatorname{poly}(N)\) time and `thm:bounded-choice` in \(d^K\operatorname{poly}(N,K)\) time. Explicitly derive the nonzero value as the directed-path coefficient product and then as \(\Sigma_{yx}/\Sigma_{xx}\). Synchronize `ThetaK`, the effect consumer prose, and `prop:projection-coverage`’s interpretation, without claiming efficient optimization over \(M\in\mathcal C_n\).
